content_of_post_to_comment: When i was a kid my parents were idiots, so I was doing 12 hours Tv a day, then 16 hours a day when i discovered internet, unless I had school. 4 years ago I discovered weed and managed to use it to stop scrolling completely for 3 years and actually did so so much, I was truly living like the 70s. Then march this year I got perscribed Duroxetine 30mg (cymbalta) for depression, i swear ts was like meth or like adhd medication or sth, at week number 3 on duroxetine, I started studying algebra 10 hours a day didnt need to move I was so engrossed, I was sweating buckets everyday, was outside from 5am to 8pm, going into cafes to study while looking crazy tweaked out, but I understood everything I read for the first time in my life. For 2 weeks I repeatedly this crazy routine while progressively becoming more violent and irritable, I had a lucid moment and realized I needed to get off it stat. After I stopped duroxetine I crashed for 1 month straight and became heavily addicted to screen again, its been 6 months I still havent been able to go a day without using screens for less than 10 hours a day. I dont even like weed that much anymore so I cant use that method to get off screens. I thought I escaped but just like that Im back to where I left it. I had lasik in 2022 and up until march my eyesight remained perfect, but after getting addicted to screens again it had gone more and more blurry. So much frustration but I cant seem to get off this shit. I quit alcohol, I quit weed, porn, nitrous oxide, but this one thing I cannot kick
